name: Rites of the Earthmother

angles.text: As a tauren, you begin a spiritual journey through the Rites of the Earthmother. They test your readiness to serve your tribe and revere the Earthmother.
As a member of the Horde, you can see the spiritual heart of your tauren allies, who have recently joined the Horde, in these sacred trials.
As an aspiring shaman, you begin with rites blessed by tribal seers. They are an essential first step toward communion with the elements and the spirits of Mulgore.
As a druid, you begin your path toward harmony with nature by honoring the sacred guidance of tribal elders and seers.

aliases: who starts rites of the earthmother
faq.answer: Chief Hawkwind directs young tauren from Camp Narache to seek Seer Graytongue in the surrounding hills.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Rites of the Earthmother?

faq.answer: Seer Graytongue lives in the hills directly south of Camp Narache, on Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore.
faq.q: Where can I find Seer Graytongue?

aliases: what are rites of the earthmother
faq.answer: The Rites of the Earthmother are sacred traditional trials where tauren youths prove their wisdom, strength, and devotion to their people and beliefs.
faq.q: What are the Rites of the Earthmother?

faq.answer: Seer Graytongue is a respected spiritual elder who lives south of Camp Narache and guides initiates through the Earthmother's sacred trials.
Chief Hawkwind leads Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa and prepares young tauren before sending them to the seers.

aliases: what do i need to do
faq.answer: You travel south from Camp Narache into the hills and speak with Seer Graytongue to report that you are ready for the trials.
faq.q: What is required to complete this task?

sections.body: On Red Cloud Mesa, Chief Hawkwind sends young tauren to Seer Graytongue in the hills south of Camp Narache. The seer guides the youth as their spiritual path begins. This journey carries them beyond everyday camp life and toward the duties their tribal customs demand.
sections.title: The Threshold of the Trials

sections.body: The Earthmother shapes tauren beliefs about creation and daily life. Her rites test maturity, resilience, and spiritual depth. Seer Graytongue warns those who reach his sanctuary that the trials call for full devotion to the traditions of the mesa.
sections.title: Embracing the Earthmother

summary: On Red Cloud Mesa, young tauren begin their spiritual journey under Chief Hawkwind's care. He sends them south of Camp Narache to Seer Graytongue, who guides their first steps toward the trials.
attribution: In-game quest text: Rites of the Earthmother
